description: This file defines the NotesSyncScheduler object which manages scheduled and immediate synchronization tasks via Android's WorkManager. It provides methods to schedule periodic syncs with network constraints and to enqueue one-off sync requests, encapsulating WorkManager interactions to centralize sync logic.

classes.name: NotesSyncScheduler
classes.description: A singleton object providing methods to schedule periodic and one-off synchronization tasks using WorkManager with network connectivity constraints.

methods.name: schedulePeriodic
methods.description: Schedules a recurring background sync every 6 hours, ensuring network connectivity before execution.

methods.name: enqueueOneOff
methods.description: Enqueues a one-time sync task that requires network connectivity, suitable for manual sync actions.
